payload.title: bundle-budget-adapter answers 'is this a static import' twice in one per-file loop, with the single-line regex STATIC_IMPORT_RE for the high-severity heavy-dependency rule and with the TypeScript AST for the route-page rule, so a Prettier-wrapped multi-line import of a heavy library is never reported and an import type of one is reported.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.ts:91 (STATIC_IMPORT_RE needs the import keyword and from on the same line)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.ts:286-310 (the heavy rule runs that regex line by line and emits a high finding)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.ts:161-170 (the AST reader of static imports, multi-line aware and type-only aware)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.ts:311-318 (both readers run in the same per-file loop)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.tool.json:47-55 (the heavy contract premise is a static import of the named library in shipped source)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.test.ts:16-20 (the heavy rule is pinned only with a one-line import star form)
payload.rule_violated: Single owner of one fact, the static imports of a module (CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 2), and the heavy rule's own premise that a static import of the library exists on the cited line.
payload.notes: A wrapped import { utils, write } from 'xlsx' split over several lines has no from clause on its first line and no import keyword on its last, so the regex never matches and heavy_dependency_statically_imported (severity high) is silently missed although the AST reader would see it. Conversely import type { X } from 'xlsx' matches the regex and is reported although the build erases it. No heavy library is imported anywhere under web at this revision (git grep), so both divergences are latent until the first heavy import is written. Close condition: Delete STATIC_IMPORT_RE and drive the heavy rule from the AST import enumerator the page rule uses (type-only skipped, with one shared test-file predicate); add heavy-rule fixtures for a multi-line import, an import type and a side-effect import. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 3). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
